name: Alprazolam
executiveSummary: Intermediate half-life benzodiazepine. Adult anxiety: **0.25–0.5 mg PO q8h** (usual max **4 mg/day**). Panic: titrate to **1–10 mg/day** divided (specialist). Elderly: start **0.25 mg q12h**. Dependence and respiratory depression — short courses.
indications:
## Indications

- Anxiety disorder; panic attacks (regimens).

## Precautions

- Dependence, tolerance, withdrawal — do not stop abruptly; limit duration.
- Potentiates alcohol/opioids/depressants → respiratory depression.
- Elderly: falls, confusion — lowest doses.
- Pregnancy/lactation: avoid if possible.

> Not long-term first-line vs SSRIs/therapy.

adulto.dose: Anxiety: **0.25–0.5 mg PO q8h**; increase slowly. Usual max **4 mg/day**. Panic: low start → often **1–4 mg/day** (some schemes up to **10 mg** — specialist). XR: once daily per label.

pediatrico.dose: Exceptional under child psychiatry — no standard ambulatory regimen.

stability:
## Stability

- Controlled substance — stock control; store per label.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Sedation, dizziness, anterograde amnesia, ataxia, dependence; rare paradoxical agitation.

bibliography.citation: FDA. Benzodiazepine boxed warning — abuse, addiction, withdrawal.
